text: 日前，在上海举行的华为全联接（HC）大会期间，华为发布了面向AI时代的Peerium计算架构，以及作为其关键互联技术的UnifiedBus灵衢总线。 发布会后，华为轮值董事长徐直军与海思首席科学家廖恒，就华为新发布的AI时代的Peerium计算架构和灵衢总线（UnifiedBus），与媒体进行了交流。
text_en: Recently, during Huawei Connect (HC) held in Shanghai, Huawei released the Peerium computing architecture for the AI era, as well as the UnifiedBus Lingqu bus as its key interconnect technology. After the launch event, Huawei Rotating Chairman Xu Zhijun and HiSilicon Chief Scientist Liao Heng exchanged views with the media on Huawei's newly released Peerium computing architecture for the AI era and the UnifiedBus Lingqu bus.
